title: YourMondayMotivator: Finished!
html:
Over the last four days I have been co-driving my friends car in the Targa North Island. It's been a huge challenge logistically, physically and mentally to finish without a scratch on the car and a fantastic result.

Going in to this we had no idea what to do but we were guided by several people with some great advice that definitely helped us complete it. Targa is like no other tarmac rally. They closed State Highways for us to drive on. Amazing. I'm writing this from my iPhone at a motel in Rotorua before we drive the car home so it's brief and might not be that readable.

But here's my thought for this morning. Choose a challenge that will push you. Find someone crazy enough to do it with you. Put in the planning, get advice from those who gave completed it before and get out there and do something incredible. The stories will last a life time.
